description: Specs that run with VALUE_E2E_UI_ONLY=1 (UI served, every /api route mocked in the spec) and that P0-9 depends on as its acceptance net. `node e2e/run-tests.mjs --offline` runs them and applies e2e/offline-ratchet.mjs: an unregistered failure fails, a registered failure that starts passing must be removed from known_failures, and a registered failure with error_must_match fails the ratchet if any of its errors does not match. Ids are '<spec file> > <test title>' (no line numbers). castle-101 needs the real service and skips itself here.
